newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end down, depressed by bond losses.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end down, depressed by bond losses.

text.p: Madrid stocks remained depressed to close down on Tuesday, tracking bonds and other key stock markets lower and after Monday's two percent gain, traders said.
The general index closed down 1.41 points, 0.34 percent, at 409.56. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares ended down 17.12 points, 0.36 percent, at 4,733.27.

"The market has followed the lead of other stock markets and although we may continue to fall a bit further in the short term, there is still firm support and the bourse will restore its upward trend in the medium term," said one trader.
Traders said they were not overly worried by Tuesday's weakness and pointed out that losses were more tame than those seen in other key stock markets.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica closed unchanged at 2,935 while Repsol rose 45 pesetas to 4,670.
Banesto was again the best performer among banks to close up 3.98 percent at 941.
In the electricity sector, Endesa fell 140 pesetas to 8,660, and Iberdrola gained five pesetas to 1,630.
